stem: Siddharth stands on a flat concrete rooftop on a hot afternoon. The rooftop has heated the air above it, and that air is warm and moist. Soon dark clouds build and rain begins.

parts.text: What happens first in the chain that produces the thunderstorm?

options.text: Warm moist air rises and creates a low-pressure area above the rooftop.
Cool air rises first and creates a high-pressure area above the rooftop.
Rain falls first and then heats the rooftop.

parts.text: Give one reason that explains why cooler air then flows in toward the rooftop.

part_answers.answer: Surrounding higher-pressure cooler air flows toward the low-pressure area above the rooftop.

teacher.key_rationale: Heated land warms moist air so it rises and leaves a low-pressure region; cooler air from surrounding higher pressure then flows in. Reversing rise/pressure or putting rain first breaks the chain.
